meta.title: ZAIROV — Engineering Digital Growth

process.title: How a project actually runs.
process.lead: Six stages. At each one it is clear what is done and what you receive.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.text: Goals, constraints, audience and the definition of done. Without this, development becomes guesswork.
steps.gets: A clear problem statement and the boundary of the first version.

steps.title: UX/UI Design
steps.text: Structure, scenarios and interface before code. You see the product while changes are still cheap.
steps.gets: A screen map and an agreed visual outline.

steps.title: Architecture
steps.text: Data, roles, integrations and how the system will grow. Map first, then code.
steps.gets: A readable system map and technical decisions.

steps.title: Development
steps.text: Interface, server side and connections. Iterations with a visible status.
steps.gets: A working product you can open and review.

steps.title: QA & Launch
steps.text: Scenario checks, go-live, training and access transfer.
steps.gets: A live system and access in your team’s hands.

steps.title: Support & Evolution
steps.text: Fixes, monitoring and growth. After handoff the product is not left alone.
steps.gets: A support plan and room to grow further.

why.title: Why teams stay until the product is live.
why.text: Since 2020 we have built websites and software systems for private business and the public sector. We cover the cycle from interface and architecture to development, integrations and support. We work formally as sole proprietor Kutman Syradzhinovich Zairov — with a contract and ownership of the result.

items.title: Built for the business
items.text: We shape the system around your process instead of forcing the business into a ready-made template.

items.title: Transparent stages
items.text: It is clear what is happening now, what comes next and how each step ends.

items.title: Deliberate architecture
items.text: Boundaries and connections first. Then code that can grow instead of being rewritten.

items.title: Room to evolve
items.text: The first version is not a dead end. Modules can be added without breaking the core.

items.title: Support after launch
items.text: Access is handed over. If the product needs to keep moving, support stays.

items.title: Clear communication
items.text: We speak in the language of the task and do not hide behind jargon. Questions get a direct answer.
